patthana23.41:1.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ navipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.41:2.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ navipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.41:3.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nanevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā ekavīsa.
